pages.text: Yarrow grows in temperate meadows. Break a mature flowering plant for its aerial material. Trauma owns treatment and preparation.
Broadleaf plantain favors moist temperate meadows. Immature plants yield no harvest.
Water mint grows at freshwater marshes and banks. Its original registry ID is preserved.
Calendula grows in warm open fields. Harvest mature flowers and replant if desired.
Marshmallow grows on moist ground. Break a mature plant for the root and planting material.
Flax grows in temperate meadows. Mature flax yields stems and seeds. Separate fibers in the crafting grid.
